stem: Business Care, Voltmarkt's device-support subscription for small offices, has an ARPA of €36 a month and a gross margin of 50%. Its monthly logo churn rates for the last 6 months were 2.0%, 2.6%, 2.2%, 2.8%, 2.6% and 2.2%. Voltmarkt computes LTV as ARPA × gross margin / monthly logo churn, using the average churn of the last 6 months. What is the LTV? Give euros with 2 decimals.
